minutes.headline: Committee set three years of preschool tuition rates; new bus contract came in slightly cheaper.
minutes.summary: The superintendent reported on a replacement bus contract after the prior carrier's bankruptcy, a small circuit breaker adjustment to the budget, and a plan to split the secretary jobs. The committee set alternate-member rules for the diversity committee, accepted donations, took up preschool tuition, and agreed to open custodial negotiations. Calendar feedback timing was also discussed.

budget_items.what_was_said: The state raised the foundation amount, so circuit breaker reimbursement falls; the private tuition line was raised to cover it.
The new carrier's daily bus rates are below the old carrier's for the remaining contract days.
Extracurricular wait time rose; clarified as a ten dollar increase.
Annual donation from a local Exxon Mobil store goes to the high school, for technology.
The primary school's box tops program generated money deposited in its gift account.
Daily rate to rise about 2.7 percent for FY15, with similar increases for the next two years; financial assistance reduces tuition received.

Alternates may attend and participate in all meetings of the diversity committee.
The school calendar will be presented once, posted for feedback, and voted at a following meeting.
